chat.text: The character cheers because something great just happened.

I replaced the fixed leg angles with planted IK feet on every ground keyframe, which fixes the foot sinking 0.35 studs into the ground at landing. To fix the arm snap I swing the arms back earlier (0.17 s) and spread the forward swing over 0.34 s. Push-off now passes through an in-between pose and landing is longer, so the knees no longer snap. The original beats stay the same: squat, V jump, landing, rebound, fist pump, settle.
plan: 0.00–0.20 s: anticipation, arms swing back first, then the body sinks into a deep squat with the feet planted
0.20–0.34 s: push-off through an in-between pose, legs extend, arms swing forward through shoulder height
0.34–0.62 s: in the air, arms snap into a wide V, chest opens, head looks up, legs tuck slightly
0.62–0.84 s: land on planted feet, then sink into a squat to absorb the weight; arms give a little
0.84–1.04 s: rebound up into the V again, head turns happily to the side
1.04–1.42 s: fist pump: hips drop and shift right, arms pull down bent, then punch back up into the V (confetti)
1.42–2.10 s: brief hold with small drift, arms come down forward and settle into a relaxed stance
